waves.launch: each own-position carrionswarm order schedules one zero-delay wave launch in j order, after current stack returns (B05)
waves.direction: dummy facing from script; absolute18*j degrees, even when ordered at its own location
waves.geometry: moving transverse line segment: at elapsed t in[0,1], longitudinal coordinate s=800*t and lateral half-width20+0.35*s; target center crossing that closed segment is contact
waves.targetPosition: piecewise-linear continuous world-center trajectory; no unit collision radius; teleport is discontinuous and does not sweep the teleport path
waves.repeat: at most once per(unit,wave); different waves independent
waves.eventTime: first qualifying geometric contact; scheduled in B05 integer-microsecond time using its rounding; same time wave creation index then target creation index
waves.boundary: 0<=s<=800 inclusive; |lateral|<=20+.35*s; endpoints included, no lingering coverage behind front
waves.unknownOriginal: shape interpolation, half-width interpretation, zero-point direction, duplicate-hit behavior, missile clock not established by supplied native code
